processes.name: Daily credit report forwarding and counterparty rebook list
processes.description: Each business day Veronica Espinoza (or Russell Diamond) distributes a Credit Report to a long list of recipients. Darron Giron then manually forwards each one, often in batches days later, to Carole Frank so his team can act on the counterparty rebook comments.
processes.stall_points: Forwarding is a manual pass-along and several reports are forwarded in a lump days after they were issued (1/24 to 1/31 reports all forwarded on 2/2). Distribution itself is delayed by systems issues.
processes.automation: Auto-route the daily credit report to the team distribution list on arrival and extract the counterparty rebook and pending items into a tracked list.

evidence.quote: I apologize for the delay on the distribution, as we had systems issues.
AEP Communications, Inc.   q00902.1  Rebook to AEP Energy Services, Inc.
Please contact Walter Guidroz at x5-3595 if you have any questions on the Aquila COLW deal.

processes.name: Flipping deals to the FT-US/CAND-ERMS book
processes.description: Stacey Vallejo repeatedly asks all book admins to find ECC and Canadian counterparty deals in TAGG and move them to the FT-US/CAND-ERMS book before invoicing or NYMEX close. Darron Giron forwards each reminder to his team and confirms back when his books are done.
processes.stall_points: Invoicing waits on every book admin confirming completion, and new counterparties (Aquila Canada, Dynegy Canada) keep surfacing as deals still showing as settling with ENA. Same-day deadlines force reminders.
processes.automation: A TAGG query or rule that flags deals with these counterparties settling with ENA and auto-flips or lists them, replacing manual book-by-book searching and reminder emails.

evidence.quote: Just a quick reminder to please go into your books and flip all the ECC deals
Please let me know when these are finished as I need to get an invoice to the customers within the next couple of hours.
Please take care of this if you have any to be flipped.  Thanks.
These deals are showing up in TAGG as settling with ENA, could you all please keep an eye out for deals with this company and flip them right away.

processes.name: Flow with no deal: extending or adding deals to clear meter exceptions
processes.description: Logistics schedulers find meters with flow but no nomination or an expired deal, and ask Daren Farmer whether to extend, copy or add a deal to clear the allocation exception. Farmer answers case by case by email.
processes.stall_points: Each exception needs a one-off question to Farmer, and fixes can be blocked (suspended counterparty cannot be extended), forcing a second round of emails near the month-end system cutoff.
processes.automation: Auto-detect meter flow with no matching deal, propose the prior-period deal for extension, and route a one-click approval to the deal owner.

evidence.quote: The meter shows flow the first two day, the deal to sell to San Jac is expired.  Do you want me to extend the deal to cover the volume?
For Dec. and Jan. production there are flow volumes without a deal.  Deal 502952 was good for November.
Deal with inactive or suspended counterparty may not be extended.
meter 1558 has flow and no nom for day 1 and day 6.
Today is the last day we can make changes in the system.

processes.name: Deal and meter point change notifications
processes.description: Mark McCoy emails Daren Farmer and colleagues after changing deal meter points, volumes or net-outs in Sitara/Tagg, often sending several follow-up corrections for the same change.
processes.stall_points: Changes are communicated after the fact and correction emails follow (effective date and additional deal numbers sent separately), so recipients must piece the change together from several messages.
processes.automation: Generate change notices automatically from the deal-change log with all affected deals and effective dates in a single message.

evidence.quote: I changed points on this deal from PGTT-TECO Waha 18002800 to PGTT-TECO
OOOPS!   This is effective the 1st.
Oh yeah, and that goes for deal 594596 Crosstex , also.
So I went ahead and changed the AEC ticket to match up with the Aquila deal.

processes.name: Counterparty payment and invoice dispute research
processes.description: Settlements and volume management staff chase down why a counterparty is disputing or has not been paid (Alpine meter 5892, Texas General Land Office sale, Torch/Cleco, PG&E/TECO, HL&P buyback). Each case runs through long forwarded email chains across scheduling, volume management, measurement and settlements.
processes.stall_points: Questions bounce between people (Karen Lindley to Fred Boas to measurement) for days, and the requester escalates in capitals before an answer arrives; nobody owns the full chain.
processes.automation: A shared dispute tracker that pulls deal, meter, nominated vs flowed volumes and allocation statements in one view and assigns an owner and due date.

evidence.quote: I am getting several phone calls from Alpine Resources demanding to be paid for meter 5892 and there is nothing there to be paid.
WOULD SOMEONE PLEASE HELP ME GET THIS MATTER RESOLVED.
Karen Lindley allocates this point but I feel the need to help her because this issue came to light while I was in transition.
Janet Wallis told me so.
Do you have a Crude Oil payable to offset this sales invoice?

processes.name: Month-end P&L, OA and daily position reporting and corrections
processes.description: Darron Giron's book admin group closes each month by completing last day files, sending economics and summary reports, reviewing P&L and OA variances, and correcting misallocated originations or liquidations. Corrections are communicated one by one in email.
processes.stall_points: Gas accounting cannot start until every desk replies that its file is done, and errors (sharing calculation, mis-coded originations, double counting) are found after the fact and fixed in the next month.
processes.automation: Automated checklist of desk completion and variance checks on P&L tabs to catch calculation and coding errors before reporting.

evidence.quote: Please reply when your last day file is complete and don't forget to provide me with your Economics Detail and Summary Level Reports.
Kevin's reported P&L was understated by the $188K on the OA Flash tab.
Please make these corrections in February in order to correct the NG P&L for the quarter.
We are taking a hit of $28,900,000 on tonight's P&L for Dec-00 production.

processes.name: Mark-to-market valuation requests for counterparty audits
processes.description: The Confirmations group asks each desk for MTM values or mini-books for specific counterparties as of a past date so the counterparty can show third party valuations to its auditors. Desk book admins pull the values by hand and export them to Excel.
processes.stall_points: There is no system with back-dated curves, so a risk person must be interrupted for each request, with Delta/Vol information blacked out, and requests often arrive with late notice.
processes.automation: Build the valuation tool with back-dated curves so Confirmations can self-serve MTM and open position reports without desk involvement.

evidence.quote: Please forward to Ellen Wallumrod the MTM valuation(mini-book) for all CoEnergy Trading Company deals as of Dec 31, 2000.
we will be coming to them often with these requests (we recieve several per week)
